description_en: Retrieves the signature parameters required for uploading RUM symbol files
description_zh: 获取 RUM 符号文件上传所需的签名参数
name: GetRumSymbolFileParams

parameters.help_en: The debug identifier of the symbol file, such as a UUID or Debug ID. This parameter is required for all file types except dsym
parameters.help_zh: 符号文件调试标识（UUID / Debug ID；除 dsym 外必填）
parameters.name: debug_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the file to upload. Valid values: sourcemap (.map), dsym (.dSYM.zip), proguard (.txt), native-symbol (.so), name-cache (.json/.txt), pdb (.pdb), sym (.sym), and symbol-zip (.zip). This parameter is used to apply for upload signature parameters. The value dimension differs from the artifactType filter parameter in the GetRumSymbolFiles query operation. Specifically, dsym (.dSYM.zip) is classified as artifactType=dsym during queries. symbol-zip (.zip) files are directly uploaded and archived with their original file names, and the current query operation does not support filtering by zip for artifactType
parameters.help_zh: 上传文件种类。取值：sourcemap（.map）、dsym（.dSYM.zip）、proguard（.txt）、native-symbol（.so）、name-cache（.json/.txt）、pdb（.pdb）、sym（.sym）、symbol-zip（.zip）。该参数用于申请上传签名参数，与查询接口 GetRumSymbolFiles 的过滤参数 artifactType 取值维度不同：其中 dsym（.dSYM.zip）在查询时归类为 artifactType=dsym；symbol-zip（.zip）按原文件名直传归档，当前查询接口 artifactType 不支持 zip 过滤
parameters.name: file_kind

parameters.help_en: The name of the symbol file to upload. The file extension must match the fileKind
parameters.help_zh: 待上传符号文件名（后缀需与 fileKind 匹配）
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RUM application service
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the application
parameters.name: version

additionalProperties.description_en: The string values for the OSS upload form fields. The field names and values are subject to the API response
additionalProperties.description_zh: OSS 上传表单字段对应的字符串值；字段名称和值以接口返回为准

formData.description_en: The collection of signature parameters required for form upload, including key, policy, x-oss-signature-version, x-oss-credential, x-oss-date, and x-oss-signature. The signatures in the examples are for illustration purposes only and cannot be used for actual uploads. Use the complete parameters returned by the API operation
formData.description_zh: 表单上传所需的签名参数集合（包含 key、policy、x-oss-signature-version、x-oss-credential、x-oss-date、x-oss-signature）。示例中的签名仅用于说明，不能用于实际上传；请使用接口返回的完整参数
formData.title_en: 表单上传所需的签名参数集合（包含 key、policy、x-oss-signature-version、x-oss-credential、x-oss-date、x-oss-signature）
formData.title_zh: 表单上传所需的签名参数集合（包含 key、policy、x-oss-signature-version、x-oss-credential、x-oss-date、x-oss-signature）

uploadUrl.description_en: The form upload URL for directly uploading symbol files to OSS
uploadUrl.description_zh: 符号文件直传 OSS 的表单上传地址
uploadUrl.title_en: 符号文件直传 OSS 的表单上传地址
uploadUrl.title_zh: 符号文件直传 OSS 的表单上传地址
